Part of [Cycling in Dublin](index.qmd). The Seapoint and People's Park counters are on the [Coastal Mobility Route](coastal-mobility-route.qmd), and the Rock Road counters are just south of the [gap at Merrion Gates](rock-road-merrion-gates.qmd). The [Blackrock DART laneway](blackrock-dart-laneway.qmd) page uses both.

Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council (DLR) has permanent automatic counters on its main cycle routes. They count every bike that passes, every hour, and the council publishes the counts as [open data](https://data.smartdublin.ie/dataset/bicycle-traffic-counts-dlr). This page turns them into charts. It checks for new data every week and updates itself when there is some.

## About the data

**Code and data.** [`fetch_cycle_counts.py`](https://github.com/fianaise/fianaise.ie/blob/main/tools/fetch_cycle_counts.py) downloads the counts. [`make_counter_page.py`](https://github.com/fianaise/fianaise.ie/blob/main/analysis/cycling/make_counter_page.py) draws this page. The monthly averages and summary are in [`analysis/cycling/data`](https://github.com/fianaise/fianaise.ie/tree/main/analysis/cycling/data) as CSV.

Source: Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council, [Bicycle Counts DLR](https://data.smartdublin.ie/dataset/bicycle-traffic-counts-dlr) and [Bicycle/Pedestrian Counter Locations DLR](https://data.smartdublin.ie/dataset/bicycle-counter-locations-dlr), via Smart Dublin, Creative Commons Attribution.
